$comment: Runtime providers for Workflow Studio. Add a provider by adding a descriptor here plus an adapter in runners/<id>.py. Keys in `defaults` are the provider's own defaults; a workflow may override any key listed in `options`.

providers.label: Local
providers.description: Hermes' own Python kernel — no Docker needed

providers.label: Docker
providers.description: The hermes-workflow container — its Python 3.12 and packages

providers.label: Modal
providers.description: Cloud sandboxes on Modal — CPU or GPU, shared volume at /data

options.label: GPU
options.help: Empty runs on CPU. GPU sandboxes run under Modal's gvisor runtime.

options.label: Image
options.help: A container image reference, or the name of an image published to Modal.

options.label: Image source
options.help: registry = container image reference (e.g. python:3.12-slim); name = image previously published with Image.publish(). The two share a syntax, so the plugin needs to be told which one the value is.

options.label: OS packages (apt)
options.help: Space-separated Debian packages baked into the image. Defaults mirror the plugin Dockerfile's apt line; empty disables the apt layer.

options.label: Python packages (baked)
options.help: Space-separated packages baked into the image with uv. Empty lets nodes install into the volume venv at run time instead.

options.label: Pip index URL
options.help: Optional index for the baked packages, e.g. https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu.

options.label: Torch index URL
options.help: Index the torch package is installed from when it is baked into the image; PyPI's torch wheel is the CPU build. e.g. https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130.

options.label: Volume venv
options.help: Venv on the modal volume that nodes run with, so run-time installs survive into the next sandbox. Empty runs the image's python.

options.label: Volume
options.help: Created on first use; shared by every node of a workflow.
